name: Sanctum validator LSTs (SanctumSpl, SanctumSplMulti)
not_assessed: how many keys it takes to move it
the time anyone has to react
the money behind one key (no money figure, or no key count)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: Both stake pool programs share Sanctum Infinity's 6-of-11 upgrade committee, with no delay. This is an upper bound: the per-LST pool managers were not enumerated.
narrative.tag: upper bound: pool managers not enumerated
narrative.detail: Both programs are re-read on every run and must resolve to the same Squads v3 committee. Each LST's pool manager is a bounded role class, like JitoSOL's, but they were not listed, so only the shared upgrade path is scored. Pools such as JupSOL inherit this target once their addresses are confirmed from a primary source. DefiLlama listed over $1.0B for sanctum-validator-lsts on 2026-09-17.

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
main_gap.reason: Changes can apply with no waiting time

independent_read.path: program -> ProgramData Cn5feg… -> upgrade authority (a program-derived address, off the curve: a Squads vault or a protocol PDA, no key can sign for it directly)
independent_read.posture: admin: a program-derived address (not a Squads v4 vault); delay: unknown
